flows.name: Find and book care
flows.goal: A patient finds a specialist, requests an appointment and sees the physician’s decision.

steps.label: Browse the directories
steps.proof: The home page and public API returned matching counts of specialist profiles, facilities and pharmacies.

steps.label: Choose a time
steps.proof: Eight fictional profiles offer appointment slots on mobile and desktop. The directory has no live connection to the specialists’ calendars.

steps.label: Request an appointment
steps.proof: The backend saved the request. An administrator saw it as pending in the internal workspace.

steps.label: Accept an assigned request
steps.proof: The assigned physician accepted the request. Another physician could not see it.

steps.label: Read the decision
steps.proof: The patient and administrator refreshed their screens. Both saw the same request marked Accepted. Both staff entry pages returned 404 on the public demo.

flows.name: Clinical visit
flows.goal: Follow an accepted appointment through to a visit summary the patient can open.

steps.label: Open an accepted request
steps.proof: The test covered physician sign-in and request handling on an isolated build with test accounts.

steps.label: Change appointment hours
steps.proof: The release includes a scheduling service and a page for managing slots. A patient still needs to verify the change in the released interface.

steps.label: Document the visit and refer
steps.proof: Source code exists for structured notes, referrals and diagnostic orders. Their connection to a single encounter remains unverified.

steps.label: Hold a video visit
steps.proof: Pages exist for both participants, along with a visit service. On the public demo, the checked URLs were closed. No two-person call was confirmed there.

steps.label: Read the visit summary
steps.proof: A published journey from a physician’s signed note to a result the patient is authorized to read remains unverified.

flows.name: Personal WHOOP data
flows.goal: From the device owner’s consent to viewing and interpreting their own measurements.

steps.label: Connect a WHOOP account
steps.proof: The server recorded one active connection. The aggregate data do not identify the owner.

steps.label: Save measurements
steps.proof: The server recorded 22 sleep events, 16 recovery events and 20 cycles. Eight syncs completed. The last was on 22 November at 16:53 Yerevan time.

steps.label: View only personal data
steps.proof: On the test build, two test patients could access only their own data. The demo rejected a signed-out request. The complete dashboard still needs verification with two real users.

steps.label: Explain trends
steps.proof: The public demo has no model connected to WHOOP. Its AI request log contained zero entries.

flows.name: Clinic shifts
flows.goal: From accepting a staff invitation to publishing an approved shift schedule.

steps.label: Accept an invitation
steps.proof: On the private test build, accepting an invitation opened an active staff session.

steps.label: View an assigned shift
steps.proof: The staff member saw their own shift. The staff session could not open the physician workspace.

steps.label: Request and accept a swap
steps.proof: One staff member requested the swap and the other accepted it in a separate session.

steps.label: Approve the request
steps.proof: A separate browser test verified the manager’s decision on another build. The combined, restricted build still keeps the manager interface closed.

steps.label: Publish the final schedule
steps.proof: Publication of the schedule and staff access to the latest approved version remain unverified.

flows.name: Prescriptions and pharmacies
flows.goal: From looking up a medicine to safe prescribing, current branch availability and dispensing.

steps.label: Find a medicine and a pharmacy
steps.proof: The demo provides a dated medicines register and a pharmacy directory. Entries identify the source and show package and dosage details where the register supplies them.

steps.label: Reconcile prescriptions
steps.proof: Code exists for reconciling prescriptions from different physicians, authorizing prescriptions and checking interactions. The latter two passed independent review. The full shared-chart journey awaits acceptance.

steps.label: Assess a conflict or alternative
steps.proof: This needs a shared list with an identifiable prescriber for each item, validated rules and a physician’s decision the patient can see. Clinical acceptance remains open.

steps.label: Confirm stock and price
steps.proof: The report found no verified feed of current stock and prices for a specific branch. The directory count measures branch locations only.

steps.label: Dispense the prescribed medicine
steps.proof: Components exist for inventory and dispensing. Fulfilling a specific prescription and updating the patient’s status on the demo remain unverified.

flows.name: Laboratory
flows.goal: Follow a test order through to delivery of its result to the treating physician.

steps.label: Order a test
steps.proof: The review found a diagnostic order module. Its connection to the full laboratory journey on the demo remains unverified.

steps.label: Register a specimen
steps.proof: Source code exists for specimen collection. The active release lacks the main file at the path cited in the report.

steps.label: Review the worklist and result
steps.proof: The worklist and validation files matched the accepted source exactly. Both components have tests. The public laboratory entry point returned HTTP 404.

steps.label: Receive the released report
steps.proof: The evidence contains no run from specimen collection to delivery of the report to the correct physician in the published workspace.

flows.name: Front desk and operations
flows.goal: From offering an available slot to managing staff, purchasing and finance.

steps.label: Offer a newly available slot
steps.proof: An earlier release was tested with a single offer recipient. Accepting the offer created an appointment request. Queue rules still need to be tested in an actual facility.

steps.label: Manage staff and service requests
steps.proof: Six modules were assembled in one test environment. Sign-in, reading and writing were verified. A workflow across all six modules still awaits acceptance.

steps.label: Review a purchase and commission
steps.proof: A separate test build verified purchase access and commission disclosure. It denied access to a user from another facility.

steps.label: Reconcile delivery, payment and stock
steps.proof: The release includes lot receipt, stock movements and recalls, forecasting, pricing and accounting. A full delivery and a real payment remain unverified.

flows.name: Medbook assistant
flows.goal: From a question the user is authorized to ask to a model answer grounded in sources.

steps.label: Ask a question under an assigned role
steps.proof: Role-based instructions and sessions were tested on an application test build. The public assistant entry point returned HTTP 404.

steps.label: Select sources and tools
steps.proof: The directory returned a source in a test interface. A separate source-integrity check failed in the gateway.

steps.label: Check access, memory and cache
steps.proof: Checks still failed after changes to permissions and context, when switching facilities and when a test package was replaced.

steps.label: Answer in the application
steps.proof: A standalone model service answered a short request. Model connections for patient and staff interfaces were disabled in the release examined.

steps.label: Assess answer quality by role
steps.proof: The application test build passed 30 of 30 checks, the browser passed 7 of 7 and the gateway passed 107 of 112. This suite made no calls to a live model.

flows.name: Build and release
flows.goal: Follow a tested user journey through the gates to Medbook’s public entry point.

steps.label: Combine two reviewed branches
steps.proof: The build brought together the directories, restricted physician workspace and WHOOP changes. The only conflict occurred in a test file.

steps.label: Test the journey across roles
steps.proof: On 23 November at 14:49 Yerevan time, the combined test build verified appointment requests and physician decisions, role isolation and a shift swap.

steps.label: Review the combined build
steps.proof: Both source branches passed independent review. At the reporting cutoff, the new combined build had no separate review decision.

steps.label: Run the standard release checks
steps.proof: In one check, collecting evidence took 48 seconds against a 25-second limit. The standard release check and release authorization for the combined version remain unverified.

steps.label: Repeat the journey on the public release
steps.proof: The public demo was running the previous release when checked. The final post-publication test is still pending.
